text: Predeclared multiplicity unit for planned confirmation: voxel index 0 is primary per cell; all other whitening-block voxels retained as diagnostics, not Monte Carlo replicates. In run-specific cells, run index 0 is primary and run index 1 plus paired cross-run dependence are retained descriptive results. Thus 36 backbone cells x coverage/null-rate endpoints = 72 rate comparisons; no raw run or voxel outcomes discarded.
